comment: The missed comparison was D<E: I assumed E’s high-rate RMSprop transformer would beat a nearly untrained GRU. Gold disproves that assumption here; it does not identify whether optimization failure or generalization caused it. K1071 helped select C but does not rank E against D’s tiny nominal progress. I overextended K1002’s undertraining warning into “D must be last.” Backtesting found conservative Adagrad beating high-rate RMSprop transformers in 13/30 finite, zero-failure lab pairs across 12 sets, all T256. Decisive history favored Adagrad in only 1/6 comparisons, also all T256. No comparable T2048 evidence supports a general reversal rule. K1102 and K1118 warn against dismissing conservative rivals, but neither matches this recipe.
